headline: Centum Investment reports 186% increase in half-year net profit
summary: Centum Investment Company Plc reported a 186% increase in net profit to Sh1.1 billion for the six months ending September 30, 2026, compared to Sh373 million in the previous year.
why: Centum is a major investment firm in Kenya; its results are a key indicator of the health of the private equity and investment landscape in East Africa.

impacts.name: Centum Investment
impacts.why: Significant profit growth reflects strong operational performance.
